changes_vs_parent.cost: 5bp on one-way turnover, charged on actual ETF/bond execution weights including risk-off transitions

execution.etf_screen: 250d correlation with the selected industry >= 0.80, keep top 8 by correlation
execution.etf_rank: 0.5 * beta percentile + 0.5 * momentum percentile, pick the best

timing: deltaAR(1.5) hysteresis x TIP 21/63/126/252 calendar gate, next-day effect, residual H11006
